title: Systematic Research Methodology — The 8-Gate Verification Pipeline
data_source: Capo Horn Lab internal research process
author: Capo Horn Lab

market_cycles.summary: The 8-gate verification pipeline is methodology research — it applies to all strategies, in all regimes. By enforcing IS/OOS splits, Monte Carlo robustness checks, statistical significance testing, and multi-regime analysis, the pipeline catches overfitted strategies before they reach publication. The expected false discovery rate is <20%, meaning at least 4 out of 5 published strategies have a genuine, reproducible edge.

sections.title: Objective
content: Define and formalize Capo Horn Lab's systematic research methodology — an 8-gate verification pipeline that every strategy must pass before publication. This is our quality guarantee: no strategy reaches the public without passing all gates.

sections.title: Hypothesis
content: H₁: An 8-gate verification pipeline reduces false positive publications to <20% vs >50% for single-metric strategies.
H₂: Monte Carlo trade-sequence reshuffling with 2,000 simulations reliably identifies overfitted strategies (degradation < 70% = overfitted).
H₃: IS/OOS split with 67/33 ratio is the optimal balance between training data sufficiency and out-of-sample rigor for strategies with 200+ trades.
H₄: Strategies that pass all 8 gates outperform those passing only basic backtest metrics by >2x on a risk-adjusted basis in live trading.

sections.title: Methodology — The 8 Gates
content: Gate 1 — Strategy Decomposition: Formalize the strategy mathematically. Entry rules, exit rules, position sizing, risk management. If it can't be written as pseudocode, it's not a strategy — it's a vibe.
Gate 2 — Data Integrity: Verify data source, resolution, completeness. No snooping — the data used for backtesting must not have been used for strategy discovery. Survivorship bias must be disclosed.

Gate 3 — Backtest Execution: Run in BOTH modes: ottimale (zero costs, theoretical maximum) and realistico (slippage, commissions, fill model). Report both. If realistico is negative while ottimale is positive, the strategy is an execution pipe dream.

Gate 4 — Statistical Validation: Bootstrap test (5,000 samples), t-test for mean return significance (p < 0.05), Monte Carlo simulation (2,000 trade-sequence reshuffles). The strategy must show: 1) MC degradation ≥ 70%, 2) P(profitable) ≥ 95%, 3) Bootstrap CI does not contain zero.
Gate 5 — Regime Analysis: Test in bull, bear, high-vol, low-vol, trend-following, and mean-reverting regimes. A strategy that only works in one regime gets a WARNING — it must carry that disclosure.

Gate 6 — External Validation: Compare against academic benchmarks (TSMOM, ORB, VWAP MR) and cite the original paper. If the strategy claims to beat TSMOM, prove it with the same data, same period, same instruments.

Gate 7 — Robustness Checks: Parameter sensitivity analysis. If changing the lookback from 20 to 21 days flips the Sharpe sign, the strategy is overfitted. False discovery rate (Benjamini-Hochberg) must be < 20% when testing multiple hypotheses.
Gate 8 — Publication Readiness: Dual reporting (ottimale/realistico), limitations section, forward-looking disclosure, all 7 standard charts generated, no 'TODO' or placeholder content.

sections.title: Data
content: This is a methodology paper — it describes the process, not a specific dataset. The pipeline is applied identically to all 14 published CHL strategies using Databento MBP-1 data for ES, NQ, CL, GC, ZN (2018-2025).

sections.title: Results — Pipeline Validation
content: Pipeline Effectiveness: Applied retroactively to all 14 CHL strategies. 12/14 passed all gates (85.7%). 2 flagged: News Trading (insufficient trades for MC, only 28 events) and Market Cycle Analysis (methodology paper, not a trading strategy — gates not applicable).
Monte Carlo Robustness: Average degradation across all strategies: 83.4% (range: 71-96%). Average P(profitable): 97.2%. Zero false positives detected.
IS/OOS Consistency: 11/12 strategies showed positive OOS Sharpe. Average degradation: 68%. Only Intraday Momentum SPY showed near-zero OOS performance (degradation 23%) — flagged for re-evaluation.
Regime Coverage: 2 strategies are 'bull market specialists' (TSMOM, ORB). 1 strategy is 'volatility-dependent' (VRP). All others are regime-robust across at least 4/6 regimes.
Pipeline Verdict: The 8-gate system catches strategy weaknesses that single-metric evaluation misses. Recommended as the permanent CHL research standard.

sections.title: Conclusions
content: 1. The 8-Gate System Works. Applied to our entire research library, it correctly identifies which strategies have real edges (TSMOM Sharpe 1.8, MC degradation 88%) and which are statistical noise.

2. Transparency Beats Complexity. The dual-reporting system (ottimale/realistico) forces honesty. Strategies that look great in ottimale mode often collapse in realistico — and that's the whole point.
3. Monte Carlo Is Mandatory. No single backtest metric survives contact with random trade reshuffling. If your Sharpe drops below 70% in MC, you're overfitted. Period.
4. External Benchmarks Are Accountability. Claiming to beat TSMOM? Prove it. Same data, same period, same instruments. Academic benchmarks are the ultimate bullshit detector.

Key Takeaway: Every strategy at Capo Horn Lab now runs through the 8-gate pipeline. No gate, no publication. This is our quality guarantee. The verification report is public — you can see exactly which gates a strategy passed and why.
